1939年4月18日

要求采取更严厉的反恐措施

据日本总领事馆于下午5时30分发布的公报称，日本领事当局昨日向上海公共租界工部局提交了一份照会，就上海特别市警察局秘书奚世泰博士遇刺一事提出交涉，并要求在租界内执行更严厉的措施以防范恐怖犯罪。公报内容如下：
“三浦义明（Yoshiaki Miura）总领事在寺崎英成（Hidenari Terasaki）先生的陪同下，于下午3时45分拜会了工部局董事会主席富兰克林（C. S. Franklin）先生，就4月11日奚世泰博士遇刺一事进行交涉，并就该事件提交了照会。
“此外，三浦先生要求今后严格执行日本当局与工部局之间达成的关于防止租界内恐怖行动的谅解。”

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.
APR 1 1 1939
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 9122 Date 14 4 39）

Ta Tao Official Killed
In Lloyd Rd. Shoot-Up;
Three Suffer Wounds

NIPPON-EDUCATED
MEDICO KILLED
OUTSIDE HOSPITAL

Japanese Wife Of Dr. Hsi Shih-Tai, Secretary
Of “Reformed Government” Police Bureau,
Avoids Fate At Side Of Husband

POLITICAL SHOOTING RESUMES

Dr. Hsi Shih-tai, well-known Japanese educated
medical practitioner and secretary-general of the “Public
Safety Bureau” of the Japanese sponsored “City Gov-
ernment of Greater Shanghai,” was assassinated at Lane
131, Lloyd Road, a few paces from his home at 9.30
this morning.

The murder this morning was the first major “execution
of traitors” since the killing of Marquis W. H. (Kuo-chieh)
Li, grandson of Lord Li Hung-chang and rumored as a candi-
date for the post as Minister of Communications in the “Re-
formed Government” in Nanking,
on Sinza Road on February 21.

C.P.C. Wounded
While Dr. Hsi was instantly kill-
ed by the assassins, a Chinese
police constable, No. 739, was
wounded in the shoulder when
seeking to overpower the fleeing
gunmen. Despite the wound, he
kept on firing, his marksmanship
greatly handicapped by the pain.
During the shooting, two more
persons were wounded. They both
claim to be pedestrians and ab-
solutely innocent of the murder.

Dr. Hsi was walking out from
his home at Dr. Lane 131, Lloyd
Road this morning, taking a short
cut by way of the adjoining Lane
131. He was accompanied by his
Japanese wife. When mid-way be-
tween his home, which is also a
private hospital, and Lloyd Road,
two gunmen accosted him and
fired at close range. He dropped
dead instantly. The gunmen im-
mediately fled, heading for Lloyd
Road, leaving the Japanese Mrs.
Hsi, who was wearing a Chinese
dress at the time, unmolested.

Gunmen Open Fire
Near the entrance of the alley,
the gunmen met the Chinese con-
stable who was rushing to the spot
upon hearing the pistol shots.
Before he could ascertain the
identity of the gunmen, he was
shot in the shoulder. Despite the
wound, he replied, but apparently
ineffectively.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》
1939年4月11日
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 S. B. 登记处 编号 S. B. D. 9122 日期 1939年4月14日）

大道政府官员在劳合路枪战中遇害；三人受伤

受日式教育的医生在医院外被杀

“维新政府”警察局秘书奚世泰博士的日本籍妻子在丈夫身边幸免于难

政治暗杀活动再起

奚世泰博士是一位知名的受日式教育的执业医师，也是日本扶植的“上海特别市政府”“治安维持会”的秘书长，今早9时30分在其住所附近的劳合路131弄被刺杀，距离其寓所仅数步之遥。

今晨发生的这起谋杀案，是自2月21日李鸿章之孙、传闻将出任南京“维新政府”交通部长候选人的李国杰侯爵（Marquis W. H. (Kuo-chieh) Li）在新闸路遇害以来，首起重大的“锄奸”行动。

华捕受伤
虽然奚博士被刺客当场击毙，但一名华籍巡捕（编号739）在试图制服逃跑的枪手时肩部中弹受伤。尽管负伤，他仍继续开枪射击，但因疼痛导致其射击准头大受影响。在枪战期间，另有两人受伤。他们均声称自己是路人，与谋杀案完全无关。

今早，奚博士从其位于劳合路131弄的家中走出，抄近道经过相邻的131弄。当时由其日本籍妻子陪同。当他行至既是其私人居所又是私人医院的住处与劳合路之间的一半路程时，两名枪手拦住他并近距离开枪。他随即倒地身亡。枪手立即逃窜，朝劳合路方向跑去，未对当时身着中式服装的奚太太进行骚扰。

枪手开火
在弄堂入口附近，枪手遇到了闻枪声赶至现场的华籍巡捕。在他尚未查明枪手身份之前，肩部即中弹。尽管负伤，他仍予以还击，但显然未能奏效。

（批：归档 8 14/4）

No. S. B. D. 9122

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS

APR 1 3 1939

Two Suspects Held
In Murder

Both Believed Implicated
In Assassination of “Ta
Tao” Official

Detectives investigating the murder
on Tuesday morning of Dr. Hsi Ts-
taung have established that the two
men at present in custody were
actually concerned in the attack, it
was reported yesterday.

One of the men, Peng Fu-lin, is at
present a patient of the Paulun Hos-
pital with a serious bullet wound in
the abdomen and his condition is so
critical at the present time that de-
tectives have been unable to ques-
tion him. The other man was ar-
rested at the Paulun Hospital on
Tuesday morning as he had accom-
panied Peng to the establishment.
Police suspicions were aroused when
it was learned that the two men had
been near the scene of the shooting
on Lloyd Road and had failed to
demand assistance after Peng was
injured, taking rickshaws to the
hospital, from where doctors inform-
ed the police that a man with bullet
wounds had just been admitted.

Detectives took the friend of the
injured man to Louza police station
where he was questioned and his
statements led the police to the belief
that both men were in some way
connected with the criminal attack
on the late secretary of the Public
Safety Bureau of the “Ta Tao” gov-
ernment.

Although no definite information
was given the press yesterday, the
“North-China Daily News” under-
stands that the injured man had
actually fired at the C.P.C. who was
injured, whilst the gunman’s wound
was caused by a bullet fired by the
Chinese policeman as the latter gave
chase to the decamping terrorists. No
weapons were found on either of the
two suspects and the belief that at
least one more man must have been
connected with the shooting is under-
stood to prevail.

Meanwhile, ballistic experts of the
Shanghai Municipal Police have care-
fully examined the bullets extracted
from Dr. Hsi’s body and it was found
that the weapon used in slaying the
official had no previous police history
in this city.

The shooting, it will be recalled,
occurred shortly after 9.20 a.m. on
Tuesday as Dr. Hsi proceeded along
an alleyway on Lloyd Road towards
his car parked in the thoroughfare.
Suddenly a gunman fired a series of
shots, killing the victim instantly
as three bullets hit him, one in the
region of the heart.

两名嫌疑人因谋杀案被拘

两人均被认为涉嫌刺杀“大道”政府官员

据昨日报道，负责调查周二上午奚世棠（原文如此，应为奚世泰）博士谋杀案的侦探已查明，目前被拘留的两名男子确实参与了此次袭击。

其中一人彭福林（Peng Fu-lin，音译）目前是宝隆医院的一名病人，腹部有严重的枪伤，目前状况危急，侦探尚无法对其进行讯问。另一人于周二早晨在宝隆医院被捕，因为他当时陪同彭某前往该医院。当警方获悉这两人曾在劳合路枪击现场附近，且在彭某受伤后未寻求帮助，而是乘坐黄包车前往医院时，引起了警方的怀疑。医院医生随后通知警方，一名枪伤患者刚刚入院。

侦探将这名伤者的朋友带至老闸捕房进行讯问，其供词使警方相信，这两人均以某种方式参与了针对“大道”政府治安维持会前秘书长的刑事袭击。

虽然昨日未向报界提供确切信息，但《字林西报》获悉，这名伤者实际上曾向受伤的华捕开枪，而该枪手的伤口则是由华捕在追击逃窜的恐怖分子时开枪造成的。两名嫌疑身上均未发现武器，据信至少还有一人参与了此次枪击。

与此同时，上海公共租界工部局警务处的弹道专家仔细检查了从奚博士体内取出的子弹，发现用于杀害该官员的武器在本市没有之前的警方记录。

回顾可知，枪击发生在周二上午9时20分过后不久，当时奚博士正沿着劳合路的一条小巷走向停在主干道上的汽车。突然，一名枪手连续开枪，三颗子弹击中受害者，其中一颗击中心脏部位，导致其当场死亡。

（批：归档 R 3/4）

pages.en:
03835

Search Continues

A city-wide search is at present
being made for other members of the
terrorist group responsible for Tues-
day's slaying whilst Peng is being
guarded by policemen at the hospital
who prevent anyone from com-
municating with him.

As a result of Tuesday's shooting,
a military spokesman of the Japanese
Expeditionary Forces in Central
China, made a statement in which he
accused the Shanghai Municipal
Council of not having followed the
recommendations made by the Japan-
ese in preventing additional outrages
in the Settlement. He also said that
certain defects in the working of the
S. M. P. were still noticeable. In
this connection, it may be recalled
that both suspects were in the hands
of the police some twenty minutes
after the shooting occurred although
their definite implication only seems
to have been established after hours
of questioning of the one suspect in
the physical position to talk.
pages.zh:
03835

搜捕仍在继续

目前全市范围内正在搜捕对周二谋杀案负责的恐怖团伙的其他成员，同时彭某在医院由警察看守，禁止任何人与其接触。

鉴于周二的枪击事件，日本华中派遣军的一位军事发言人发表声明，指责上海公共租界工部局未遵循日本方面提出的防止租界内发生更多暴行的建议。他还表示，工部局警务处在运作中仍存在某些缺陷。在此方面，值得回顾的是，两名嫌疑人在枪击发生后约二十分钟内即落入警方手中，尽管似乎是在对唯一具备身体条件接受讯问的那名嫌疑人进行了数小时的审问后，才确立了他们的确切牵连关系。

pages.en:
03842
CHINA PRESS.
APR 1 3 1939

Another Assassination

ONCE again a Chinese puppet official has been laid low by an assassin's bullet, and once again we reiterate our view that such acts of terrorism, notwithstanding their motives, in the long run accomplish no purpose whatsoever but even serve to defeat the cause for which the daring attempts are made.

As we stated before, it is not on any moral grounds whatsoever that we oppose terrorism. We have no sympathy for any of the victims. It is purely a matter of practical results. If terrorism were to contribute to China's cause, then we would whole-heartedly endorse it. But since terrorism in any political movement never has advanced that movement, but has caused it to retrogress, we therefore condemn it as a method.

Terrorism operates on the false premise that by the removal of certain personalities, a new state of affairs can be brought about. This springs from the so-called "devil theory" of history in which objective conditions are interpreted solely in the light of personalities. This school regards Mussolini and Hitler as historical accidents, not on the agenda of the day, neglecting at the same time the obvious fact that these gentlemen are but the reflection of the economic and social conditions which produced them. The assassination of either dictator would change the Italian and German states not in the slightest, nor does the assassination of puppets in China seriously impede Japanese efforts to organize their regimes.

If a political aim can be accomplished by terrorism, then it follows that all that is necessary is to kill off a few people. But even the most ardent advocates of terrorism don't lay claim to being able to achieve such results. Terrorism results from entirely misplaced emphasis and understanding, and a totally false evaluation of the means of struggle. It is at best an isolated act of despair, whatever be the patriotic motives. The history of Germany and Russia proves conclusively that terrorism plays into the hands of the enemy. Though we may sympathize with terrorists, we cannot but condemn their work as harmful, in the long run, to China's cause.

（批：Q 13/4 C 12/4）
pages.zh:
03842
《大美晚报》
1939年4月13日

又一起暗杀事件

又一次，一名中国傀儡官员倒在刺客的子弹下，我们再次重申我们的观点：此类恐怖主义行为，无论其动机如何，从长远来看都达不到任何目的，甚至反而破坏了那些大胆尝试所要追求的事业。

正如我们此前所述，我们反对恐怖主义并非基于任何道德理由。我们对任何受害者都没有同情。这纯粹是一个实际结果的问题。如果恐怖主义有助于中国的事业，那么我们将全心全意地支持它。但是，既然恐怖主义在任何政治运动中从未推动过该运动的发展，反而导致其倒退，因此我们谴责这种方法。

恐怖主义基于一个错误的前提，即通过清除某些人物，可以带来新的局面。这源于所谓的歷史“魔鬼理论”，即仅从个人角度来解释客观条件。这一学派将墨索里尼和希特勒视为历史偶然，不在当前的议程之上，同时忽略了这样一个明显的事实：这些先生们不过是产生他们的经济和社会条件的反映。刺杀任何一位独裁者都不会丝毫改变意大利和德国的国家状态，同样，在中国刺杀傀儡也不会严重阻碍日本组织其政权的努力。

如果恐怖主义能够实现政治目标，那么结论就是只需杀死几个人即可。但即使是最狂热的恐怖主义倡导者也不敢声称能取得这样的结果。恐怖主义源于完全错位的重点和理解，以及对斗争手段的完全错误评估。无论出于何种爱国动机，它至多是一种孤立的绝望行为。德国和俄罗斯的历史确凿地证明，恐怖主义是在帮敌人的忙。虽然我们可以同情恐怖分子，但我们不得不谴责他们的行为，因为从长远来看，这对中国的事业是有害的。

（批：Q 13/4 C 12/4）

pages.en:
NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,
03794
APR 1 2 1939
Pro-Japanese Official Shot
Dead by Terrorists

Military Spokesman Indignant, Accuses S.M.C. of
"Policing Defects"; C.P.C., Pedestrian Wounded

AFTER two and a half months' of inactivity, anti-Japanese
terrorists went into action yesterday and killed Dr. Hsi. Ts-
taung, secretary of the "Public Safety Bureau" of the Japanese
sponsored "Special Municipality of Shanghai", as he was leaving
his residence in Lane 139, Lloyd Road, shortly after 9.20 a.m.
Two gunmen stood at the entrance of the alleyway, fired a number
of shots, three of which injured the victim, and decamped. C.P.C.
730 who was near the scene, took up the chase, ordered the two
gunmen to halt and when they refused to do so, he drew his
service pistol, fired two shots and sagged to the ground as one
of the terrorists fired once more to wound the policeman slightly
in the right shoulder. Notwithstanding his injuries, the C.P.C.
arose from the pavement and gave chase, but meanwhile the two
gunmen had been successful in disappearing in the crowd.

A pedestrian on the opposite side
of Lloyd Road who had come into
the line of fire, was injured in the
abdomen and is now lying in the
Paulun Hospital in a very serious
condition.

S.M.C. Criticized

This assassination brought forth
criticism on the part of Lieut.-Col.
Mabuchi, Director of the Press
Bureau of the Japanese Expeditionary
Forces to Central China, in a state-
ment made yesterday afternoon, in
which the Shanghai Municipal Police
is accused of not having adopted mea-
sures suggested by the Japanese
authorities in preventing terrorist
outbreaks.
"We are constrained to declare that
there are still several defects in the
policing activities of the Shanghai
Municipal Council", the Japanese
officer stated, "inasmuch as that the
Council was to take ample precau-
tions against outrages of this sort by
adopting measures suggested by the
Japanese authorities following the
assassination of Mr. Chen Loh".
In the same statement, the spokes-
man said that it was desirable that
agencies alleged to be maintained by
the Chungking Government in the
International Settlement should be
closed, and that publications, which,
according to the same spokesman,
received their instructions from the
Chungking Government, should be
closed down as well.
The deceased was struck by three
bullets, one entering the left side, just
below the heart and emerging from
the chest, one on the left side of the
neck and another on the right side
of the neck. Death was presumably
instantaneous but an ambulance was
called and Dr. Hsi was taken to the
Paulun hospital where he was de-
clared dead on arrival.

Many Shots

The exact number of shots fired by
the assassins, could not be ascertained
as they used revolvers, which fact
also left the police without the usual
cartridge clue which could have
possibly enabled them to trace the
police history of the pistol, if any.
Nevertheless, it is believed that about
ten shots were fired in all, two by
the C.P.C. and about eight by one of
the gunmen. It was not believed that
the second gunman did any shooting,
although here, too, statements made
by persons near the scene of the
firing at the time, are rather con-
tradictory.

（批：Lie C 1/4 R 2/4）
pages.zh:
《字林西报》，
03794
1939年4月12日
亲日官员遭恐怖分子枪杀

军方发言人表示愤慨，指责工部局存在
“警务缺陷”；华捕、行人受伤

在沉寂了两个半月之后，反日恐怖分子于昨日采取行动，于上午9时20分过后不久，在日本人扶植的“上海特别市”“公安局”秘书奚自强（Hsi Ts-taung，音译）博士离开其位于劳合路（Lloyd Road）139弄的寓所时将其杀害。两名枪手站在弄堂口，连开数枪，其中三枪击中受害者，随后逃窜。当时就在附近的华捕730号展开追捕，命令两名枪手站住，因对方拒绝服从，他拔出手枪射击两发，但随即倒地，因为其中一名恐怖分子再次开枪，轻微击中了该警察的右肩。尽管负伤，这名华捕仍从人行道上起身继续追赶，但与此同时，两名枪手已成功混入人群消失无踪。

劳合路对面的一名行人
被卷入交火范围，腹部受伤，
目前正躺在宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital），
情况十分危急。

批评工部局

此次暗杀事件引来了日本华中派遣军报道部部长马渊大佐（Lieut.-Col. Mabuchi）的批评。他在昨日下午发表的一份声明中，指责上海公共租界工部局警务处未采纳日本当局为防止恐怖活动爆发而建议的措施。
这位日本军官称：“我们不得不宣布，上海公共租界工部局的警务活动仍存在若干缺陷，因为在陈箓先生遇刺后，工部局本应采取日本当局建议的措施，对此类暴行做好充分防范。”
在同一份声明中，该发言人表示，据称由重庆政府在公共租界内维持的机构应予关闭，且据该发言人称，接受重庆政府指令的出版物也应予以取缔。
死者身中三弹，一弹从左胸心脏下方射入并从胸部穿出，一弹击中颈部左侧，另一弹击中颈部右侧。死亡推测为瞬间发生，但仍叫来了一辆救护车，将奚博士送往宝隆医院，抵达时被宣告死亡。

多发枪击

由于刺客使用的是左轮手枪，无法确定其确切射击次数，这一事实也使警方失去了通常可通过弹壳线索追踪手枪来源（如果有的话）的机会。尽管如此，据信总共发射了约十发子弹，其中华捕发射了两发，一名枪手发射了约八发。据信第二名枪手并未开枪，尽管在此问题上，当时在枪击现场附近人员的证词相当矛盾。

（批注：Lie C 1/4 R 2/4）

pages.en:
Japan Returned Student
Dr. Hsi was a graduate of the
Nippon Medical College and had
practised medicine in Shanghai for
the past 20 years. He also owned a
private hospital and was understood
to be interested in a number of im-
portant business firms in this city
Whilst he is known to have been
married to a Japanese woman, he
also had a Chinese wife and a con-
cubine. He was the father of seven
children, the elder being 24 years
old.
Since the assumption of his new
duties as secretary of the "Public
Safety Bureau", Dr. Hsi made it a
practice to leave his home at the same
time each morning, his car, bearing
licence number 3147 and painted of
a very conspicuous blue, usually
waiting on Lloyd Road at the imme-
diate exit of the alleyway.

Cultural Worker
Japanese circles yesterday claimed
that Dr. Hsi had done a great deal
of work in the cultural field and that
"there is reason for greater indigna-
tion at this dastardly attack if the
relations existing between the victim
and the Japanese Army are taken into
account."
Plain-clothes Japanese gendarmerie
arrived at the scene a few minutes
after the ambulance had left with Dr.
Hsi and the C.P.C. They made preli-
minary investigations and left the
scene a few minutes later, whilst at
about 12 o'clock noon, four or five
Japanese pressmen armed with
cameras and suitcases filled with
flash-bulbs, were seen walking into
Louza Police Station, being presum-
ably under the impression that the
corpse was being kept there. They
left the station a few minutes after-
wards.
By a late hour last night, no fur-
ther arrests had been made in con-
nection with the shooting, notwith-
standing the fact that a large number
of detectives from Louza station and
headquarters were still working on
the case feverishly at the time of
going to press.

Previous Assassinations
The last political assassination to
have occurred in the International
Settlement, was that of Marquis Li
on the afternoon of February 21, when
the Marquis was walking along
Avenue Road with a friend, on his
way to consult a physician.
As a result of this murder and that
of Mr. Chen Loh, Minister of Foreign
Affairs of the "Reformed Govern-
ment" in Nanking, the Japanese
authorities made a series of protests
to the Shanghai Municipal Council as
a result of which an agreement was
reached according to which closer
co-operation of the Japanese authori-
ties and the Shanghai Municipal
Police were arranged. Lloyd Road
where the shooting occurred, runs
parallel with Yu Ya Ching Road, and
enters Nanking Road south of the
Sun Sun Co.'s department store.
A curious turn of the shooting may
be found in the fact that the injured
pedestrian did not ask for assistance
at the scene, although in a serious
condition, but arranged his own
transportation to the Paulun Hospital,
where the doctors informed the police
that a man with gun-shot wounds had
been admitted.
Meanwhile, the injured man, whose
name is given as Peng Fu-lin, 23, a
native of Soochow, has been placed
under police surveillance at the
Paulun Hospital, until an improve-
ment in his condition will permit
detectives to question him. A friend
who accompanied him to the hospital
was questioned by detectives at Louza
police station and it was understood
that he has been detained, although
this could not be confirmed at a late
hour last night. As far as could be
ascertained just before going to
press, it will be some considerable
time before the seriously injured man
can be questioned, provided that he
recovers at all, and it seems some-
what premature to classify him as a
witness.

02795
pages.zh:
留日学生
奚博士毕业于日本医科大学，过去二十年在上海行医。他还拥有一家私立医院，据悉对本市多家重要商号拥有利益关系。虽然众所周知他娶了一位日本妻子，但他还有一位中国妻子和一名妾室。他是七个孩子的父亲，长子24岁。
自从担任“公安局”秘书这一新职以来，奚博士养成了每天早晨同一时间离家外出的习惯，他的汽车悬挂牌照3147号，漆成非常显眼的蓝色，通常停在弄堂出口处的劳合路上等候。

文化工作者
日本方面昨日声称，奚博士在文化领域做了大量工作，并且“如果考虑到受害者与日军之间现存的关系，就有理由对这次卑鄙的袭击感到更加愤慨。”
便衣日本宪兵在救护车带走奚博士和华捕几分钟后抵达现场。他们进行了初步调查，几分钟后离开现场，而在中午12点左右，四五名携带相机和装满闪光灯泡的手提箱的日本记者被看到走进老闸捕房，大概是误以为尸体停放在那里。几分钟后他们离开了捕房。
截至昨晚深夜，尽管老闸捕房和总部的许多侦探在截稿时仍在紧张地处理此案，但与此枪击案相关的逮捕行动未有进一步进展。

此前的暗杀事件
上一次发生在公共租界的政治暗杀是2月21日下午的李侯爵（Marquis Li，音译）遇刺案，当时李侯爵正与一位朋友沿爱文义路（Avenue Road）行走，前往就医。
鉴于此次谋杀以及南京“维新政府”外交部长陈箓先生遇刺案，日本当局向上海公共租界工部局提出了一系列抗议，结果达成了一项协议，据此安排了日本当局与上海公共租界工部局警务处之间的更紧密合作。发生枪击案的劳合路与虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Road）平行，并在先施公司（Sun Sun Co.）百货商店以南汇入南京路。
这起枪击案有一个奇特的转折，即受伤的行人虽然伤势严重，却未在现场求助，而是自行安排交通工具前往宝隆医院，医生在那里告知警方有一名枪伤男子入院。
与此同时，这名伤者名叫彭福林（Peng Fu-lin，音译），23岁，苏州人，已被置于警方的监视之下，待在宝隆医院，直到其病情好转允许侦探对其进行讯问。陪同他去医院的一位朋友在老闸捕房接受了侦探的讯问，据悉他已被拘留，尽管昨晚深夜时尚无法证实这一点。据截稿前所能查明的情况，这名重伤者若能康复，也需要相当长的一段时间才能接受讯问，因此将他归类为证人似乎为时过早。

02795

pages.en:
02796

Press Conference Statement
At the press conference yesterday,
the army spokesman, supplementing
Lieut.-Col. Mabuchi's statement,
hoped that the Council would take
measures to curb such activities. A
redeeming feature of the affair was
the gallant action of the Chinese
constable who opened fire on the
assailants, he added. Further, the
Japanese Consular Police had been
informed by the Municipal Police
that one of the wounded men was
considered as a suspect, but full de-
tails were not available.
In reply to questions, the spokesman
stated that the Japanese had not
asked for the custody of the suspect
and that so far no protest had been
registered by the Japanese authori-
ties with the Municipal Council.
pages.zh:
02796

新闻发布会声明
在昨日的新闻发布会上，军方发言人在补充马渊大佐的声明时表示，希望工部局采取措施遏制此类活动。他补充说，此事的一个可取之处在于那位向袭击者开火的华捕的英勇行为。此外，工部局警务处已通知日本领事警察，其中一名伤者被视为嫌疑人，但详细情况尚不清楚。
在回答提问时，发言人表示，日方并未要求羁押该嫌疑人，且截至目前，日本当局尚未向工部局提出任何抗议。
